page0.text:
The girl returns to her bedroom.
She goes to her bed with heavy steps and sits down limply.

page1.text:
"...Senpai's hurt so badly, and he still..."
She doesn't know what happened.
She just knows that the boy left and came back a few hours later looking haggard and covered in wounds.
The blonde girl who suddenly appeared in this house a few days ago didn't return with him.
From this alone, it's clear that something irrevocable has happened.
The boy is hiding something, and as a result, the blonde girl didn't come back.

page2.text:
"..."
But that doesn't matter.
She doesn't care about that at all.
As long the boy is back safe, then she doesn't need to know what happened.
Nothing could make her happier than Shirou Emiya coming home to her.

page3.text:
"Wait...was it this cold today...?"
She feels a chill, and touches her cheek.
...It's hot.
Her whole body feels hot, and she feels like she might faint if she doesn't concentrate.
It must be a cold again.
That's unusual, since she doesn't usually catch colds, but she was waiting at the door for almost three hours.

page4.text:
"...Ngh..."
Sluggishly, she turns off the lights.
Too tired to even change out of her clothes, she collapses into bed.

page5.text:
"It's okay. Compared to what Senpai's going through, this is nothing..."
Lying face down, the girl thinks back to the scene a few minutes ago.
...His back looked like someone worked it over with a cheese grater.
...His stomach was bruised black, as if struck by a heavy, blunt weapon.
...He had to have been wounded in both body and spirit, yet his gaze was as clear as day.

page7.text:
The moment she remembers, she feels her body temperature rise.
She pretends not to notice that it's hatred she feels, not excitement.

page8.text:
"Who did that...?"
...Yes.
She can't forgive whoever hurt him this badly.
This goes beyond momentary feelings like hatred or disapproval.
He's always been deeply hurt, and yet, he's always stayed here with her, so pristine.
He's someone so different from her yet so precious, so she can't abide the fact that someone hurt him.

page9.text:
"Mm...but...Senpai's back was amazing..."
She absently reaches out with her hand.
It's been a long time since she saw his bare skin up close.
When they first met, he was small for a boy, and not much taller than her.
But for the last two years, he has rapidly become a man.

page11.text:
It wasn't like before, when he collapsed from a cold.
That was only a common cold.
Tonight, he was a wounded man.

page12.text:
"Senpai..."
Her mind goes blank as she remembers.
When he exposed his chest, she was surprised by how masculine he was, covered muscles trained every day without rest, and not a gram of excess.
If she had to compare his lithe body to that of an animal, he would be a wild goat. Small and beautiful, yet with the hidden strength to scale sheer cliffs.

page13.text:
"Yeah...and his chest was so broad...so manly..."
Her outstretched fingers trace the lines of a chest that isn't there.
Unconsciously, they run up his body's lines like water drops.
From his chest to his neck...
Her fingers glide across the sheets, from his neck to his lips...
"Ah."
Her face goes bright red.

page14.text:
"I-I'm so stupid!"
In a panic, she tucks her arms in.
The girl rolls into a ball on her bed, her ears turning just as red as her face.
It shouldn't be this embarrassing, but the memory of his touch is just too fresh.
The sensation of his skin on her fingertips just makes her imagination that much more vivid.

page15.text:
"Senpai..."
She clenches her hands tightly.
She brings her face and hands in, trying to ball up the warmth heating her body.
She can't think of anything else.
She clutches her hands to her chest, clutching close the residual sensation in finger tips.
"Senpai..."

page16.text:
She endures the heat boiling up through her body.
She won't be able to hold on if she lets it out.
If that happens, she won't even be able to think of this one thing she's clinging to.

page17.text:
"I'm...sorry..."
She's hounded by confusion and guilt towards the boy.
His injured body. Just the thought of the bloody marks on his back makes her dizzy.
The girl who will never come home again. What she took from him. All the lies.
Dark emotions she would normally never even entertain twist inside her, awakening a feeling of delight deep within...

page19.text:
She calls out to him to try and bury the feelings.
How long can she keep them down?
She hugs her chest so tightly it contorts.
Thoughts bubble up within her bosom.
"Ha..."

page20.text: The only thing making her this happy, this relieved, is that the boy came home to her.

page21.text: "That's all I want, but Senpai, you..."

page22.text:
...It isn't enough.
She knows that now.
He takes such good care of me, but he's trying to protect me by pushing me away.

page23.text: "No, we can't have that, Senpai. I want to be by your side..."

page24.text:
She says her thoughts aloud.
She knows how greedy she sounds.
But because it's a desire that shouldn't be voiced, a wish that can't come true...

page26.text:
She moans her repentance.
How vile she is, for delighting in his injuries.
How decadent she is, for wanting to waste his efforts to protect her.
It feels like a betrayal for someone like her to want to be with him.
So she apologizes.
The repentance and contrition quench her fever.

page27.text:
"Ah...hah...ah..."
She curls up in bed, damp with sweat.
Her guilty conscience awakened a fever that was somehow like arousal.
Even though the fever has cooled, she feels troubled by a heavy agony.
His wounded body...
He's still going to fight, even after going through that.

page28.text:
"What should I do, Senpai? You're going to get hurt even worse, now..."
She frets, covered in sweat.
It's a worry she doesn't have an answer for, and a problem she can't solve.
She could think all night and still not come up with a way to stop the boy.
Except...

page29.text:
"Oh, I know. I can just stop him from going outside."
With a relieved sigh, she arrives at an utterly simple answer.
The girl breaks into a smile of someone who just had a divine revelation, feeling deep relief.
Yeah. If I hurt you so you can't walk anymore, then you won't get into any danger, Senpai.
She murmurs as if addressing someone.
